# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 to 16 years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c3 P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008)</sub>
- **Status:** Orphan  <sub>[v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Student; later Schoolteacher at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- **Titles:** Avery Scholarship Winner  <sub>[v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Nell with an E  <sub>[v1 c3 P21](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0021), [v1 c3 P24](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0024)</sub>; Lucinda  <sub>[v1 c3 P15](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0015)</sub>; Lady Lucinda Fitzgerald  <sub>[v1 c8 P54](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0054)</sub>; Rosamond Montmorency  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>; Carrots  <sub>[v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell begins as a very thin, pale, and small girl with a sharp chin, prominent brow, wide mouth, freckles, and thick red hair worn in long braids. Her eyes vary between green and gray depending on the light and her mood. As she grows older, she grows quite tall and slender, her freckles fade, and her bright red hair darkens to a rich auburn.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c28 P4](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0004), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v1 c37 P32](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0032)_

## Personality

Nell is an intensely imaginative, passionate, and loquacious girl with a penchant for grand words and romantic ideals. Highly sensitive to beauty in nature and literature, she often escapes into vivid daydreams and invents creative names for her surroundings. Though prone to dramatic outbursts and a fierce temper when teased about her appearance, she possesses a deeply affectionate, grateful, and generous spirit. Over time, she learns to govern her passionate outbursts, developing a dedicated work ethic and a profound sense of duty to those who love her.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P29](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0029), [v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P41](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0041), [v1 c10 P30](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0030), [v1 c12 P46](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0046), [v1 c27 P20](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0020), [v1 c31 P21](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0021), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020)_

## Goals

- To belong to a real home and family where she is loved  <sub>[v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 c8 P12](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0012)</sub>
- To become attractive and grow out of her red hair  <sub>[v1 c7 P21](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0021), [v1 c10 P35](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0035)</sub>

- To care for Thirza and save Grey Shutters from being sold  <sub>[v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023)</sub>

## History

Sent by mistake from the Marden asylum to Brierley instead of a boy, Nell is brought to Grey Shutters by Obed Abernethy. Though initially unwanted by Thirza Abernethy due to her gender and loquacious nature, Nell's imagination and charm win over both Obed and Thirza, who decide to keep her. She quickly makes Grey Shutters her beloved home, forms a close friendship with Isolde Pembroke, and begins attending Brierley School under Mr. Pidgeon. Despite early mishaps—such as a fiery outburst at Agatha Sowerby, accidentally getting Isolde drunk on currant wine, and accidentally dyeing her hair green—Nell settles into community life and excels academically. In a fierce academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow, Nell works tirelessly under her beloved teacher Miss Thorne, ultimately passing the Entrance Exam and winning the prestigious Avery Scholarship to Wexcombe College. However, after Obed dies of a sudden heart attack and Thirza's eyesight threatens to fail, Nell selflessly forfeits her scholarship to remain at Grey Shutters. She accepts the teaching position at Brierley School—yielded to her by Hugh Carrow—reconciles with Hugh, and commits herself to caring for Thirza and their home.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c12 P28](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0028), [v1 c16 P48](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0048), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c27 P16](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0016), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia to high school teachers Edmund and Bertha Harcourt  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011)</sub>
- Orphaned at three months old when both parents died of fever  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by Mrs. Thomas until age eight, assisting with her children  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Adopted by Mrs. Rudge up-river to help care for eight children, including three sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Spent four months in the Marden orphan asylum before being brought to Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>

## Quotes

> Should you merely agree to address me as Nell with an E added, I will endeavor to accept that I am not named Lucinda.  <sub>[v1 c3 P23](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0023)</sub>

> Experience has taught me that if a person firmly resolves to enjoy things, they almost always can.  <sub>[v1 c5 P0](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0000)</sub>

> My life is a perfect graveyard of buried hopes.  <sub>[v1 c5 P3](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0003)</sub>

> I will perpetually refer to it as the Petal Road of Delight.  <sub>[v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053)</sub>

> With God residing in his heaven, everything on earth is as it should be.  <sub>[v1 c38 P63](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0063)</sub>
